newsitem.title: USA: Big Flower Press to offer $250 notes.
newsitem.headline: Big Flower Press to offer $250 notes.

text.p: Big Flower Press Holdings Inc said Tuesday it would offer $250 million of 8-7/8 percent senior subordinated notes due 2007.

The company said it will not register the new notes under the Securities Act of 1933, and the notes may not be offered or sold in the United States without registration or an applicable exemption therefrom.
The company also said it intends to tender for its 10 3/4 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003, of which about $126.7 million are outstanding, upon completion of the new note issuance.
